hints.title: Set membership
hints.body: Store every occupied coordinate in a hash set so corner checks are constant time.

hints.title: Four directions
hints.body: For a fixed corner and side, the square can extend northeast, northwest, southeast, or southwest.

hints.title: Check three partners
hints.body: For each direction, the other three corners are determined; require all four corners, including the query corner, to be occupied.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
occupied = set of unique points
answers = []
for each [x, y, side] in queries:
    if (x, y) not in occupied:
        append 0 to answers
        continue
    count = 0
    for dx in {-side, side}:
        for dy in {-side, side}:
            corners = [(x, y), (x + dx, y), (x, y + dy), (x + dx, y + dy)]
            if every corner in occupied: count += 1
    append count to answers
return answers
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
